what: Section title — when its top edge rises above the 85% line of the screen, the large English line rises into its slot from the bottom (100%) over .6s. .4s later the 2px ink underline beneath the small line grows from the left over 1.2s, and its letters rise one by one at .1s intervals over .25s (all curves cubic-bezier(.45,1,.6,1)). look: vertical is vertical-writing copy — on each line a right-hand vertical rule grows from the top over 1.2s while the letters slide in from the right (100%) at .1s intervals. Turned sideways on a phone, the letters come from below and the rule becomes an underline

options.[data-fx-part=en]: Large line (rises within its own cell, optional)
options.[data-fx-part=sub]: Small underline stroke — splits the text (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=line]: One line of look: vertical (vertical line·letters) — if there are two or more, each is delayed by line-gap
options.on: scroll (default, 85% line) · ready (as soon as attached — sub page header title) · load (after images are all loaded — hero copy)
options.start: on: ScrollTrigger start for scroll, default top 85%
options.delay: Start delay (s), default 0 — hero copy is 2
options.sub-delay: Small line underline · text delay (sec), default .4
options.line-gap: look: vertical delay between rows (sec), default 1.1
options.lead: look: vertical time from the line to the first letter (s), default .1
options.dur · char-dur · line-dur · ease: English line (.6), letter (.25), and rule (1.2) durations, curve

from.where: All section titles .cb-title (original .title.-view·.c_ttl body.-ready) · hero vertical copy .cb-hero__catch (look: vertical · on: load · delay 2, original .hero_catch)
